newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Egana Int'l places shares to 3rd party.
newsitem.headline: Egana Int'l places shares to 3rd party.

text.p: Quartz watch manufacturer Egana International (Holdings) Ltd said on Tuesday 60 million shares of HK$0.10 each of its share capital were placed to an independent third party at HK$2.05 per share.
The placement would be done by Peninsula International Ltd (PIL), a company owned by Hans-Joerg Seeberger, chairman of the Egana Group, it said in a statement.
The placing price represents a discount of about 5.6 percent to the close of its share price of HK$2.125 per share on November 4.
Trading of Egana's shares in Hong Kong was suspended on Tuesday morning at its own request.
PIL has also agreed to conditionally subscribe 60 million new shares at a price equivalent to the net price payable to it.
The placement represents some 4.5 percent of existing issued share capital of Egana and 4.3 percent of its enlarged share capital after the placement and subscription.
PIL now owns 640.85 million shares of Egana, or 55.9 percent of Egana's existing issued share capital. After placement and subscription, PIL would own some 53.5 percent of the enlarged share capital.
Proceeds, estimated at HK$120 million, would be used to expand Egana's distribution network in Europe and the United States, as well as for general working capital.
